1) DocuSign envelope routed by Redwood operations (Ben) — target: 2027-05-27 17:00 PT (blocking)
2) RedShift countersign (procurement/legal) — target complete: 2027-05-28 23:59 PT (blocking)
3) Billing setup confirmed (Karthik) — billing contact + payment terms verified: 2027-06-01 (blocking for start if dedicated capacity)
4) SOC2 snapshot and procurement pack received by RedShift — status: received 2027-05-24 (Monica)
5) Day-zero onboarding resource scheduled (Grace) — target schedule sent to RedShift by 2027-06-02
6) Capacity reservation (if required) — reserved by 2027-06-01 (Ben)
7) Kickoff runbook & scheduled time for week 1 — shared by Grace by 2027-06-04

If all blocking items clear, we will treat 2027-06-14 as Start-of-Service and plan a focused handover week (2027-06-14 to 2027-06-18) with daily 30-minute standups. If any blocking item slips, we will communicate a 48–72 hour soft delay window.

Action items for immediate next 24 hours:
- Ben: please route the single-docs envelope (MSA+SOW+PO) and share the DocuSign link here when done.
- Karthik: confirm billing lead and any documents required to complete payment onboarding.
- Monica: share the procurement pack text file to the RedShift procurement distribution (Hannah Lee).
- Tom/Hannah: confirm whether procurement wants the PO inside the same envelope or as a separate workflow.
